title: Inverted dropout
summary: Inverted dropout with a given random generator: training forward with an exact mask, backward with the same mask, identity at inference.

mutants.backward_no_scale: Multiplies the gradient by the mask but forgets to divide by 1 - p.
mutants.eval_draws_from_rng: Draws from the generator in inference mode, so later random numbers change.
mutants.eval_scales_down: Multiplies the input by 1 - p in inference mode, as the non-inverted form does.
mutants.keep_with_probability_p: Keeps an entry when the random number is below p, so the mask is the complement.
mutants.no_scaling: Applies the mask but does not divide the kept entries by 1 - p.
mutants.scale_by_p: Divides the kept entries by p, not by 1 - p.
